name: finops
description: Answers cloud cost questions on AWS, GCP, and Kubernetes: why a bill went up, whether analysis matches an invoice, where to save money, and a recurring report compared with the last one. Every number in a report is proved against saved query results.

interface.shortDescription: Answer cloud cost questions with numbers a script has proved
interface.longDescription: Use FinOps to answer cloud cost questions on AWS, GCP, and Kubernetes: it finds which billing data exists, asks once for a query budget, reconciles to the invoice, explains what changed, and reports savings. Every number in a report is proved against saved query results before the report is written.
defaultPrompt: Use finops to find out why my cloud bill went up.
Use finops to reconcile my GCP invoice with the billing export.
Use finops to find where we can save money.
